notes.title: STEAM SALE!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/c319c4c5c1ab82a1407b706e48fd19f1baf38dc1.jpg

Today the steam winter sale has started, which means that you can buy our games (for yourself or your friends) with a big discount!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/6360e7ce72609f4f9d2119c3f57cee5c9238c621.jpg

Also, I would like to mention that we have created unique packs, which give an additional discount. One package will allow you to complete our games collection (if you haven't played all our games), and the second one will allow you to buy all EvilBoobsCult (and another publisher) games at once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/8fd2396481c08680c18e372558d3d9f04aaab82c.jpg

Christmas and New Year will be here very soon! Our games can be a great gift for your friends... or your enemies... it's a matter of taste.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/ceb81842a390c9cbcc54923be83f30840fea2937.jpg

Also, don't forget to add our new projects to your wishlist! It will help us out a lot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/628cc83c5a0fcfb2165ccae60fb2c7e5862b4ff6.jpg

Happy Holidays!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/c23646ef3d78154d7e94df23c0182a6556684084.gif

And never forget your protective gear, it's important!
